facts.text: Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
facts.possibly_moot: Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows about her night visits and is not interested, and she left crestfallen (beat_58, beat_60); Ingrid never released Dunk.

facts.text: Ingrid has been secretly visiting Warwick at night, while Warwick, who gets night visitors almost every night, calls them incomprehensible and slept well the one night they stopped. Will Ingrid's visits stop now that Sir Phidipaldi told her Warwick knows and is not interested?
